references.text: The king of Gezer is mentioned among the kings whom Joshua defeated during the conquest of Canaan.
Describes Joshua's attack on Lachish, the city to which the king of Gezer came to help.
Mentions Gezer and the Canaanites who lived there, highlighting the city's continued significance in Israelite history.
States that Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, showing that the city was not fully conquered.
Pharaoh captured Gezer and gave it to his daughter as a dowry when she married Solomon.
Parallel to the complete destruction of an enemy without leaving anyone alive, as with King Og of Bashan.
Mentions the Canaanite peoples that Israel was to fight against, including those living in the lowlands.
